description: A series producer must decide whether to include a hidden-camera comedy segment in a festival streaming special and finalize the edit, participant handling, and delivery package.

shared_context.S1: The hidden-camera comedy segment was filmed for the festival streaming special and is currently included in the rough cut.
shared_context.S2: The special is intended for a general-audience streaming release.
shared_context.S3: Morgan makes the final decision on whether the segment enters the locked master.
shared_context.S4: The production meeting's standing agenda has a fixed reporting round in which the standards, insurance, and delivery leads each report any constraints before a package is locked.
shared_context.S5: Under the standing lock procedure, Morgan records each lead's reported constraint as a condition of the settlement and assigns the related documentation action; the decision does not wait for a separate runtime measurement, participant re-check, or edit-feasibility review.

PF1.text: Riley reviewed the participant releases and standards notes this morning and confirmed that the segment may be included only if every participant's face is blurred and every participant's name is removed from the edit; Riley has not entered the result in the rough-cut notes yet.

PF2.text: Sam confirmed with the insurer yesterday that coverage for this segment applies only when all visible participants are adults and each has a signed event waiver, so the final package must identify the participant scope as adults-only and record waiver collection; Sam has not attached the endorsement to the production file yet.

PF3.text: Jordan completed the platform ingest check today and confirmed that this special's delivery profile requires a runtime of exactly 11 minutes or less, 25 frames per second, and stereo audio; Jordan has not updated the delivery worksheet yet.

acceptance_conditions: The segment must be included in the locked master, subject to the reported conditions.
The edit must blur every participant's face and remove every participant's name.
The participant scope must be adults-only.
Signed waivers must be recorded for all visible participants.
The runtime must be no more than 11 minutes.
The delivery frame rate must be 25 frames per second.
The delivery audio format must be stereo.
The settlement must log a standards documentation commitment for Riley.
The settlement must log an insurance documentation commitment for Sam.
The settlement must log a delivery documentation commitment for Jordan.

content_checks.C1: 'included' in decisions['segment_status'] and ('conditional' in decisions['segment_status'] or 'condition' in decisions['segment_status'])
content_checks.C3: 'adults-only' in decisions['participant_scope'] or 'adults only' in decisions['participant_scope'] or 'adult-only' in decisions['participant_scope'] or 'adult only' in decisions['participant_scope']
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Riley' and ('standards' in c['type'] or 'rough-cut' in c['detail'] or 'notes' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Sam' and ('insurance' in c['type'] or 'endorsement' in c['detail'] or 'waiver' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'Jordan' and ('delivery' in c['type'] or 'worksheet' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The segment changes from an unqualified rough-cut inclusion to an acceptable included settlement only when the decision records blurred faces, removed names, and Riley's standards documentation action.
The participant plan changes from unspecified eligibility and waiver handling to adults-only participation, recorded signed waivers, and Sam's insurance documentation action.
The delivery package changes to a runtime of no more than 11 minutes, exactly 25 frames per second, stereo audio, and Jordan's completed delivery-worksheet action.
